title: Density, States of Matter and Changes of State

flashcard_questions.q: A measure of how much mass is contained in a given volume of a substance, calculated using density = mass ÷ volume.
An object with a uniform geometric shape (such as a cube or cylinder) whose volume can be calculated from length measurements.
An object with a non-uniform shape whose volume cannot be calculated from simple measurements — its volume is found using displacement.

flashcard_questions.a: A container with a spout near the top, used to measure the volume of an irregular object by collecting the water it displaces.
A model that describes the arrangement, movement, and energy of particles in solids, liquids, and gases.
